stateAndContentTranslationBoundary.runtimeCallOrder: Source-enforced precondition, not a Figma property: in the ComponentFactory::applyCalls path, resolve and load a leading or trailing icon before setContentMode(IconOnly); then make the chosen icon visible and enter iconOnly. Z_PushButton::setIconOnly throws without a loaded visible icon, and requires accessibleName or derives it from nonempty text. Set control size and content mode before setLoading, because setSize and setIconOnly reject changes while loading. QtMapping.cpp's direct button construction currently applies icon sources and visibility before setIconOnly, then setLoading; generic applyCalls does not enforce this ordering. This is a generator admission rule, not runtime validation or authorization to rewrite the generator.
